summary: Phase 0 POC end-to-end test pass (backend pytest + frontend Playwright). All 10 backend tests passed (health, ingest idempotency, conversation CRUD, chat with passages, history append, empty-message 400, cascade delete, latency < 30s, voice quality). All frontend flows passed (home navigation, geometry canvas + 5 nodes + hint fade on pointerdown, mercurius welcome, OPENINGS dropdown with 6 starter prompts, thinking indicator, assistant response, conversation sidebar entries, new-thread reset, custom send via button and Enter key).

issues: Top node 'Light' HTML billboard is positioned partially outside the visible viewport at default camera (only 'visible · articulated · conscious' subtext is shown near the top edge). Cosmetic — orbit easily reveals it. Consider slightly lifting the camera or reducing the top-node label translate so the 'LIGHT' label is visible on first paint.

action_items: Optional (cosmetic): nudge default camera or top-node label so 'LIGHT' label is fully visible on initial paint of /geometry.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:194 uses `logger` inside a try/except before the module-level `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` is defined (the logger var is created at line 244, after `app.include_router`). In the current execution order this works because the function is called at request time (after module load), but it is fragile — if a retrieval exception occurs during module import or testing in isolation, NameError could surface. Consider moving the `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` and `logging.basicConfig` to the top of the file, before the route definitions.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI `@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown')`. Migrate to a `lifespan` context manager to avoid future-version breakage.

Mercurius.jsx is ~600 lines and mixes a tiny markdown renderer, dropdown, sidebar, and chat. Acceptable for Phase 0 POC; flag for refactor into `MarkdownLite.jsx`, `StarterDropdown.jsx`, `ConversationSidebar.jsx` if the component grows.
chat.py `_load_system_prompt()` is invoked on every chat call — fine at this scale; a module-level cache would shave milliseconds.
test_credentials: None required — single-user POC, no auth.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed conversations and clean them up via DELETE after each test; one prior chat-created conversation may have been left in DB (visible as sidebar item 'TEST_delete_cascade — what is the bicone?' was deleted by the cascade test). Sidebar showed 9 conversations during UI run, including ones created during the run; main agent may run a one-time cleanup if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_mercurius_api.py covers all 10 contract tests, runs in ~44s due to live Claude calls. Frontend: data-testid coverage is excellent — home-link-{geometry,mercurius}, geometry-page, node-{light,dark,pi,inversion,lived-actuality}, geometry-hint, mercurius-page, welcome-message, starter-prompts-{button,dropdown}, starter-prompt-0..5, chat-input, send-button, new-conversation-btn, thinking-indicator, conversation-list, message-{user,assistant}-N. Blockquote rendering in MarkdownLite (Mercurius.jsx lines 58-72) is correct; model output simply may or may not include a `> ...` block depending on prompt. Voice quality 'no sycophancy' is verified — assistant response to 'What is π doing at the equator?' contained 'π'/'equator'/'paradox'/'bicone' and no 'great question', 'happy to help' phrases.
